# angel-agent-guard

> MIT-licensed TypeScript library, CLI and stdio MCP server that guard an AI agent before it acts: guardUntrusted(textOrUrl) checks untrusted content for prompt injection (local pass + hosted 17-language scan), verifyBeforePay(urlOrToken) checks any shop, checkout or payment link, paid API, x402 endpoint or ERC-20 before buying, paying or approving (TLS, domain age, look-alikes, redirects, payment provider, card fields, injection scan of the page). Zero runtime dependencies; optional viem for automatic x402 v2 payments.

## Install

- `npm i angel-agent-guard` (add `viem` to pay automatically)
- MCP (stdio): `npx -y -p angel-agent-guard angel-agent-guard-mcp`; tools guard_untrusted, verify_before_pay, quick_scan
- Coinbase AgentKit: `import { angelGuardActionProvider } from "angel-agent-guard/agentkit"`
- CLI: `npx angel-agent-guard scan "<text>"`, `npx angel-agent-guard verify <url> | --token 0x...`

## API

- guardUntrusted(input, { fetch?, payerAddress?, apiKey?, remote? }) → { verdict clean|caution|hostile|unchecked, action use|read_only|drop|review, score, findings, cleaned, hiddenMessage, payment, error }
- verifyBeforePay(url | token | { url, method, token, chain }, { maxAmountAtomic?, networks?, fetch? }) → { ok, verdict pay|caution|do_not_pay|unchecked, riskScore 0-100, kind checkout|shop|api|x402|web, merchant, injection, reasons, local, preflight, token, errors }
- quickScan(text) → offline findings (unicode_tags with decoded text, markdown_image_with_query, bidi_control, zero_width, variation_selector, long_base64) and cleaned text
- checkOffer(offer, { url, maxAmountAtomic, networks }) → static checks of a decoded x402 v2 offer
- createX402Fetch({ privateKey | signer, maxAmountAtomic = 1000000 }) → a fetch that pays x402 v2 "exact" offers on EVM after checkOffer passes
- fence(source, content) → content wrapped in an unpredictable boundary, marked as data
- Python (pip install angel-agent-guard): verify_before_pay, guard_untrusted, quick_scan; tools for browser-use, LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI — https://github.com/daoudandiaye98-alt/angel-agent-guard/tree/main/python
- angel-agent-guard/ai-sdk: guardUntrusted(), verifyBeforePay(), quickScanUntrusted(), angelGuardTools() as Vercel AI SDK tools (ai 5, 6, 7)

## Hosted checks

- Base https://angel.oroboros-design.com; endpoints POST /agenten/signal/stealth-read {url} (readSafeUrl: page as clean Markdown), /agenten/signal/input-guard {text|url}, /agenten/signal/preflight {url, method} (any commerce URL), /agenten/signal/token-risk {token, chain}
- 3 free calls per agent (X-Payer-Address or X-API-Key, else per IP); then USDC on Base via x402: safe read 0.02, pre-purchase check (preflight) 0.015, input guard 0.015, token risk 0.015 (under the $1 default cap of @x402/core)
- Docs: https://angel.oroboros-design.com/docs/prompt-injection-defense/ and https://angel.oroboros-design.com/docs/x402-integration-guide/
